text: {"components": [{"type": "condition", "quote": "EU/EFTA citizens wishing to carry out a regulated professional activity in Switzerland for a maximum of 90 working days per calendar year", "gist": "EU/EFTA citizens limited to 90 days per year for regulated professional activity in Switzerland"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "submit a declaration form to SERI before providing the service", "gist": "Submit declaration form to SERI before service provision"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "If the professional activity has a potential impact on public health or safety, vocational and professional qualifications will be carefully checked by the competent authority", "gist": "Qualifications checked if activity affects public health or safety"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Processing times for service providers are shorter than the recognition procedure for people moving to Switzerland", "gist": "Service provider processing is faster than relocation recognition procedure"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SERI", "gist": "Swiss authority for service provider declarations"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "online portal", "gist": "Digital platform for centralised procedure"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "90 days per calendar year", "gist": "Maximum allowed working days per year for EU/EFTA citizens"}]}
